title: Release Runbook: WMS 7.4 at Kestrel Point Distribution Centre

headings.text: Release Runbook: WMS 7.4 at Kestrel Point Distribution Centre

key_sentences: This runbook describes how to deploy release 7.4 of the warehouse management system to the production cluster at Kestrel Point.
The release introduces wave picking for chilled goods and replaces the label printer gateway.
Set the image tags and the feature flag in the environment file before running the pipeline.
If a rollout does not finish within ten minutes, stop and go to section 5.
Rollback restores release 7.3.2 and the database snapshot taken during the pre-checks.
Orders created after the snapshot must be re-imported from the transport management system.

rows: Test label printed with new layout
No orders stuck in status ALLOCATING

list_items.text: Confirm the change is approved in the change calendar
Check the state of the cluster
Disk usage on database volumes below 70 %
Trucks scheduled after 22:00 are loaded manually
Take a database snapshot and record its identifier
Put the site into maintenance mode from the operations console.
Run the database migration job and wait for it to complete.
Deploy the services with the commands below.
Take the site out of maintenance mode.

code:
release: "7.4.0"
images:
  wms-api: registry.internal/wms/api:7.4.0
  wms-picking: registry.internal/wms/picking:7.4.0
  label-gateway: registry.internal/wms/label-gateway:2.0.3
features:
  chilled_wave_picking: true
  legacy_label_spooler: false
replicas:
  wms-api: 4
  wms-picking: 3

kubectl config use-context kpdc-prod
kubectl -n wms apply -f release-7.4.0.yaml
kubectl -n wms rollout status deploy/wms-api --timeout=10m
kubectl -n wms rollout status deploy/wms-picking --timeout=10m

SELECT status, COUNT(*)
FROM outbound_order
WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY status;
